title: a loan not charged off's credit balance refund posts overpayment 200.0 -> DEBIT 16 200.0, CREDIT 4 200.0 (loan 1 L5)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a loan CREDIT BALANCE REFUND posted, ported from createJournalEntriesForLoanCreditBalanceRefund (AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:2113-2170, pinned 426a23544), on the Tier-D `LoanCBR.feature` MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.credit_balance_refund_journal.transaction_id is L5, the sweep transactionId of the read-back's transaction id 5 (type loanTransactionType.creditBalanceRefund, amount 200.0). The portions transcribe principalPortion 0 and overpaymentPortion 20000 of that read-back transaction, converted from the decimal major units to integer minor units by exact decimal parsing (never a float); the observed identity amount = principal + overpayment holds (20000 = 0 + 20000). The loan is NOT charged off (read-back chargedOff false, fraud false), so determineAccrualAccountForCBR sends the principal debit to LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5. The refund was posted with paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 6 (AUTOPAY), which has NO channel mapping (the only channel mapping in the product is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19), so the default product FUND_SOURCE 4 is credited, exactly the account the observed credit names. request.credit_balance_refund_journal.accounts transcribes the accepted product mapping .softhouse/capture/tierd-feasibility/cbr-mnt/product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json (sha256 6d0a6fe543f26cb9733156c82697e4fd3603f266bfcba851424ccfa6558f9471): fundSourceAccountId 4, loanPortfolioAccountId 5, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 15, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 11. expect.credit_balance_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the posting legs under L5 in id order: DEBIT account 16 200.0; CREDIT account 4 200.0. This vector grades ONE property: the principal portion switches from LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 to CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 15 once the loan is charged off, and to CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 11 when it is also fraud, while the overpayment debit and the single total credit to the fund source are unchanged. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
